notes: BIMO clinical-investigator letter (not a manufacturing facility inspection): informed-consent and investigator-oversight violations under 21 CFR 812/50 during a clinical study of the INSTI HIV Self-Test investigational device. Classified as 'device' since the cited regulations (21 CFR 812) and subject product are device-related, even though CBER issued it. location_contains omitted: the letter states an inspection of 'your clinical study site' occurred but never names its city/state (the recipient's mailing address is Dr. Fallon's own address, not stated as the study-site location), so neither a location value nor the 'no facility inspection' null case cleanly applies. fei omitted is not needed (using null) since this is an individual investigator, not a registered facility. violation_categories is a judgment call: none of CGMP/sterility/adulteration/misbranding/unapproved_new_drug/compounding apply to this BIMO letter, but 'data_integrity' is included for the described record alterations (white-out changes) and mismatched/incomplete study records (Section 4).
